absent: Locking, interrupt context and ordering rules for the ASID bitmap, generation counter and per-processor active and reserved values.
How the pending translation flush mask is consumed and when invalidations become visible to other processors.
Translation base register programming and installation of the allocated context identifier.
Allocation, sizing and lifetime of scalable and matrix extension state buffers and vector length selection.
Establishment of the virtual dynamic shared object mapping and the value of the minimum signal stack size.
Selection conditions between alternative ELF base, data, platform and stack mask configurations.
Semantics of individual relocation codes beyond their numeric values.
Callers and error handling for firmware capsule cache maintenance.

findings.text: A context identifier packs a hardware address space number with a software generation in one 64-bit word, with one helper isolating the number portion by masking and another installing a generation by combination.

Address space numbers are retained while still recorded as reserved on any processor or pinned by the address space, otherwise a free number is claimed from a shared bitmap above zero; when none remain the global generation advances, reservations are rebuilt from per-processor state, and deferred translation invalidations are requested for later switches.

On generation advance the allocation bitmap is seeded from pinned assignments when present, otherwise from kernel user split reservations when the kernel is unmapped at exception level zero, otherwise cleared; split mode reserves alternating numbers so that kernel and user halves form pairs distinguished by the low bit.

A floating point restore entry for the current task tolerates machines without vector support by clearing its deferred marker and returning, otherwise it acquires processor-local vector context, reloads task state when marked foreign, and rebinds the task before releasing context.

Processor-local vector context is guarded by masking bottom-half delivery when interrupts permit it, with preemption control used under realtime builds, through paired acquire and release helpers with symmetric behavior.

Task vector reload adapts to the recorded floating format and to available scalable and matrix extensions, covering plain, scalable and streaming configurations plus control and auxiliary state, sourcing per-task lengths through vector-type queries and converting lengths to quadword counts where needed.

Reload helpers restore control words plus the full vector file, scalable state split into data, predicate and fault regions sized by current length, and matrix state as a square region plus an optional table, using iteration abstractions that expand one operation per architectural register.
When matrix extension support is compiled out, the length query reports zero and the state reload path is marked unreachable, so callers must avoid invoking reload in that configuration.

Native general state is an array of unsigned words sized by the user register view with a rule copying kernel register storage into dump format, floating state reuses the user SIMD structure, and compat general state is eighteen 32-bit entries.
Architecture ELF state is a small object holding integer flags with one defined bit for branch target identification, initialized to zero.

Property handling ignores compat inputs, validates length for the AArch64 feature property and records branch protection only when hardware allows it, while program header and header validation hooks accept all inputs with success.

Process setup zeroes the first argument register, selects native or compat personality with respect to 32-bit mode and executable-stack implication, publishes the virtual dynamic shared object address and minimum signal stack size through auxiliary entries, uses register sets for dumps, and sizes execution pages by the base page size.
Return to user space covers two deferred work items, one delivering a segmentation fault for asynchronous tagging errors and one reloading foreign floating state.
Capsule handling cleans and invalidates data cache over a caller range, and the generic memory set name aliases an internal implementation.
Three headers provide single-inclusion markers.
